entries.title: We Planted a Mango SEED. What Grows FIRST? (Part A)

moments.what: Round 1: what does a mango seed grow into first?
Observing: look again and again, not only twice
We use our five senses to gather information about plants
Through the window in the pot: the root grows first, then the shoot
New mango leaves are red at first, then turn green
A seed grows into a young plant first
A young plant: a thin stem, a few leaves, no flowers or fruits
Journey: be the mango seed, the root goes down, the shoot goes up
The seed grew into a young plant
Measure the height of a plant with a ruler
HOLD ON! Measuring from the table is not fair
Put the zero of the ruler on the soil: the plant is 12 cm

entries.title: The Mango or the Seed: Which Came FIRST? (Part B)

moments.what: Round 1: an old mango tree in flower: which stage is it in?
A young plant beside an adult plant: thin stem or thick trunk
The young plant grew into an adult plant with flowers and fruits
Only the adult plant has flowers and fruits
Where do new mango seeds come from? Not the roots
Journey: be a mango flower that grows into a mango with a seed inside
New seeds grow inside the fruits, not in the roots
Seed, young plant, adult plant, and its fruits bring new seeds
There are three stages in the life cycle of a plant
Showdown: the adult plant is not the last stage
The stages in a life cycle are repeated: no first or last stage
Life cycles repeat so a kind of plant does not disappear
Singapore's seed bank keeps seeds safe
A seed bank stores seeds safely until they are needed
